comments.comment:
After DCO-11530 (ubuntu26 tests VMs should use coreutils-from-gnu) was resolved, sanity-sec test 41 passed:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/cf13bc4d-bf72-4852-a9a1-d888fc78ea4f
